title: Secure Embedded Dashboard
prompt: Embed a report with a descriptive title, sandbox restrictions, minimal permissions, and a privacy note.
objective: Use iframe title, sandbox, loading, and an explanatory paragraph.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: iframes, sandboxing, permissions.
hints: Confirm that the provider allows embedding. Add permissions only after documenting why they are needed.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Confirm that the provider allows embedding. Add permissions only after documenting why they are needed. Required structural evidence: <iframe, title=, sandbox=, loading=.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
